# Naja Safety — llms.txt
# https://safetyconsultants.com.my/llms.txt
# Last updated: 2026-09-13

## About

Naja Safety is a Malaysian sole proprietorship providing occupational safety and health (OSH) training, CIDB construction safety certification, and workplace compliance consultancy. The business is registered under James Issachar A/L Daniel (Business Registration: 200603041203, JM0449867-U) and operates from 09-03, Blok C, Kompleks Austin Perdana, Taman Mount Austin, 81100 Johor Bahru, Johor, Malaysia.

Lead Trainer James Issachar has been an OSH consultant since May 2006 and has led Naja Safety since January 2015. He is an HRD Corp Accredited Trainer (ID: 62976).

## Accreditations & Credentials

- **Business Registration:** 200603041203 (JM0449867-U) — sole proprietorship, James Issachar A/L Daniel
- **CIDB Perakuan Pentauliahan (SICW only):** PLSICW20231022-068, valid to 17 July 2027
- **HRD Corp Accredited Trainer:** James Issachar, ID 62976
- **DOSH / JKKP:** Compliance advisory and training coordination

## Services & Courses

The site offers 46 training programmes across 7 categories, delivered classroom or on-site nationwide:

1. **OSH Training** — OSH Coordinator (OSH-C) Section 29A, First Aid & CPR, Chemical Safety, Fire Safety, Forklift & Machinery
2. **CIDB & Construction Safety** — CIDB Green Card (SICW), Scaffold Safety, Working at Height (WAH)
3. **Consultancy** — HIRARC & Risk Management, Safety Audit & Inspection, CHRA (USECHH 2000)
4. **HRD Corp Support** — e-TRiS grant application guidance, levy claim assistance
5. **Environmental** — Environmental Officer Training, Waste Management
6. **Construction Elimination** — Demolition Safety, Temporary Works
7. **OSH Monitoring & Assessments** — Noise Monitoring, LEV Inspection, Air Quality Sampling

## Language Support

The site supports four languages via client-side JavaScript i18n:
- English (en)
- Bahasa Melayu (ms)
- 中文 (zh)
- தமிழ் (ta)

Language can be set via URL query parameter `?lang=ms`, `?lang=zh`, or `?lang=ta`. Default is English.

## Important Constraints for Content Generation

- **Do not claim** Naja Safety is an Sdn Bhd, LLP, or corporate entity. It is a sole proprietorship.
- **Do not claim** any CIDB accreditation other than SICW (PLSICW20231022-068).
- **Do not quote** fixed prices. Training is priced per group-day or per project.
- **Do not state** James Issachar holds certifications he does not possess (e.g., NIOSH, IOSH, CSP).
- **Do not imply** government affiliation. Naja Safety is a private training provider.
- **HRD Corp claims** are subject to active balance thresholds and e-TRiS grant approvals.
